note: Numbered amendments to docs/ui-editor-gate-rules-repourl.md (locked in 9b7be19). Each is labelled pre-score or post-run.

A1.kind: pre-score, a flaw in my own locked text and CSS, found when the control of the scorer check failed B, before any scored run
A1.what: The UI Editor page passes asideSize 'narrow' to PageHeader, so its header class is is-aside-narrow (a 30% aside column), not is-aside-wide as the locked rules section 1 and my first CSS said. The CSS rule and the source test now name .page-header.is-aside-narrow; nothing else in the rules changes (the measured lead wrap, 2 lines at 1280, 1366 and 1440 px with the button and no CSS, is the same). The first scorer run (control F: B failed, 1280 lead 2 lines; F1 to F4 failed the items they target but B was already failing, so they proved nothing about B) is on record and the scorer check is rerun in full.

A2.kind: pre-score, flaws in my own locked rules found when the control of the rerun scorer check still failed B, before any scored run
A2.what: (1) Locked B demanded the tool top within 0.5 px of main at 390 px as well. On a phone the button cannot sit out of the grid: it goes under the title block, which adds its row (+48.56 px at 390, the button 34 px plus the header gap), as ShopAI's does; the brief asks for the ribbon position at 1280 and the lead lines, not a phone offset. B now requires the tool-top match at widths above 640 px, and at 390 requires the same lead lines, no overflow and the button inside the window; the 390 offset is reported. (2) The Q07 and B01 specs measure the page at 1000 px, below my first breakpoint (1100 px, ShopAI's), where the button would have stacked and moved the ribbon; the out-of-grid rule now starts at 641 px (the site's phone width) and 1000x800 is added to the measured sizes (the five sizes of the rules plus 1000). Checked at 1000, 800, 700, 642 and 640 px: the button never overlaps the title, chips or lead. The rules' section 2 item 2 and the new test say 641 px where the locked text says 1100 px. The two earlier scorer runs (first: control failed B on the wrong class; second: control failed B at 390) are on record; the scorer check is rerun in full.

A3.kind: post-lock, after the scored run and the whole gate on d674aa8 (labelled as such; it follows them)
A3.what: Max approved new wording for the credits sentence that said the engine is kept in a private repository (src/data/uiEditor.ts, credits.items): 'The editing engine is the author’s own code, in its own public repository on GitHub, and shipped in this site as one built file.' (the rest of the paragraph is unchanged).
